high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from "The Indian Express," a news website. The article discusses the external affairs minister's briefing to opposition parties regarding India's policy on Afghanistan following the Taliban takeover. The text highlights that the main focus was on India's evacuation efforts but also mentions that the government's policy is to wait and watch. The article notes that the Modi administration has prioritized safe passage for Indian citizens and minorities of Indian origin over Afghan allies.
